findings.evidence: Repository-wide `rg` finds the new API only at lines 108–175; it contains the kernel identity and dense-span theorem but no `LinearIsometry`, `LinearIsometryEquiv`, comparison, or uniqueness declaration.
findings.fix: Add the universal-property theorem: any other Hilbert-space feature map realizing `K` induces a unique linear isometry from `KolmogorovSpace`, and when its feature span is dense this upgrades to a linear isometric equivalence, with the map characterized on feature vectors.
findings.issue: `inner_kolmogorovFeature` and `kolmogorovFeature_dense` establish a minimal realization but provide no uniqueness/comparison API, so consumers cannot use the claimed canonical decomposition without unfolding its RKHS implementation.

summary: The computational lemmas now have the required automation annotations, but the canonical minimal decomposition lacks its universal property.
